page.content:
Quyagen is a Great Old One in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Crispin Burnham and E. P. Berglund for their short story "The Thing in the Library".

page.overview:
What is Quyagen?

Quyagen is a Great Old One in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Crispin Burnham and E. P. Berglund for their short story "The Thing in the Library".

Quyagen is the god of Yagothoggua, mentioned in The Black Book of the Skull, which takes the form of an enormous shadowy, horned creature with a mass of tentacles. The god is served by the Y'nathogguans and is worshipped by blood sacrfices, most famously through the "brides of Quyagen". It used the Eye of Zysl'm against the Great Race of Yith until it was imprisoned under the temple at Yagothoggua. It might be related to Othuyeg.
